checks.name: startup
checks.label: Startup
checks.evidence: Recorded when the authenticated field-check observer starts; home-bundle timing is a separate performance observation.

checks.name: foreground-recovery
checks.label: Background / foreground recovery
checks.evidence: Recorded when this page becomes visible after the browser reported it hidden.

checks.name: sync-acknowledgment
checks.label: Sync acknowledgment
checks.evidence: Recorded when a naturally occurring sync write receives its server acknowledgment.

checks.name: production-run-save-sync
checks.label: Production-run save and sync
checks.evidence: Recorded after a production-run save; success requires server acknowledgment, interruption is incomplete, and only bounded duration/cause codes are retained.

checks.name: spec-import-review-commit
checks.label: Spec import parse, review, and commit
checks.evidence: Recorded after the spec-import review/commit flow; cancellation is incomplete, success requires persisted changes, and only bounded duration is retained.

checks.name: cross-device-convergence
checks.label: Cross-device convergence
checks.evidence: Recorded when this browser applies a naturally occurring peer or merged update.

checks.name: reload-persistence
checks.label: Reload startup
checks.evidence: Recorded after a full-page reload followed by authenticated observer startup; saved-data persistence is not checked.

checks.name: offline-recovery
checks.label: Offline recovery
checks.evidence: Recorded when the browser reports returning online after an offline interval.

checks.name: offline-queue-replay
checks.label: Offline queue replay
checks.evidence: Recorded when a queued offline operation receives server acknowledgment after connectivity returns.

checks.name: pwa-update-handoff
checks.label: PWA update handoff
checks.evidence: Recorded when a service-worker update is ready or an update handoff is initiated; this does not confirm recovery.

checks.name: stale-deployment-recovery
checks.label: Stale-deployment recovery
checks.evidence: An update attempt is incomplete until an authenticated startup on a different build; same-build or interrupted attempts remain unconfirmed.

checks.name: performance
checks.label: Performance
checks.evidence: Records home-bundle load, page-navigation load, and API timeout/network timings against their reviewed budgets.

checks.name: touch-accuracy
checks.label: Touch accuracy
checks.evidence: The app cannot verify physical touch accuracy without guided human confirmation.

checks.name: keyboard-clearance
checks.label: Keyboard clearance
checks.evidence: The app cannot verify visual keyboard clearance across physical devices.

checks.name: orientation-layout
checks.label: Orientation layout
checks.evidence: A manager visually confirmed that the working screen remains usable after rotating a physical device.

checks.name: safe-area-clearance
checks.label: Safe-area and fixed-navigation clearance
checks.evidence: A manager visually confirmed controls are not obstructed by device safe areas or fixed navigation.

checks.name: camera-file-selection
checks.label: Camera and file selection
checks.evidence: A manager confirmed the physical device can open and cancel its camera or file picker without uploading production data.

checks.name: update-handoff
checks.label: Update handoff
checks.evidence: A manager confirmed the guided update and reopen protocol on a physical device.

checks.name: process-kill-recovery
checks.label: OS process-kill recovery
checks.evidence: The app cannot prove OS process-kill behavior without a guided device check.
